app_store.name: Plainfare: Rides, Price Locked
app_store.subtitle: Locked fares, open driver pay
app_store.promotional_text: The price you see before you book is the price you pay. Drivers see what we keep on every trip.
app_store.description:
Plainfare is a local ride service with nothing hidden on either side.

For riders:
- Price lock: the fare you see before you request is your charge. It only changes if you change the destination or keep your driver waiting past the free minutes.
- No fee when it isn't your fault: if your driver cancels, is late, or never heads your way, there's no cancellation fee.
- Share your live trip with anyone, without sharing your name or number.
- Ride for someone else; we text them the driver's details.
- Card or cash.

For drivers:
- Every offer shows what the rider pays and what we keep.
- Keep 80% of each fare after the booking fee, plus all tips and wait time.
- No pause without a written reason, and a one-tap request for a human review.

Now in New York City.
app_store.whats_new: First release: price lock, open fare split for drivers, live trip sharing.
